## Local <span class="latex">L<span>a</span>T<span>e</span>X</span>

These tools are maintained by SCC-UConn, the Statistics Department Computing
Committee at UConn.

* [UConn Thesis](https://github.com/scc-uconn/UConnThesis):
  <span class="latex">L<span>a</span>T<span>e</span>X</span> thesis
  template with BibTeX references, statistical examples, and reproducible R
  code and figures. Originally contributed by Marcos, Xiaojing, and Greg;
  now maintained under the scc-uconn organization.

* [UConn Stat Department Letterhead](https://github.com/scc-uconn/UConnLH):
  <span class="latex">L<span>a</span>T<span>e</span>X</span> letterhead
  template for the UConn Department of Statistics,
  maintained under the scc-uconn organization.
